verdict.rationale: Kick is a SaaS accounting platform, so official SDKs are a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never mentions any SDK or client library. The programmatic surfaces it does document are an MCP server and a CLI, which are separate capabilities and not SDKs. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the llms.txt and markdown doc mirrors are GitBook platform features, not a Kick-built developer interface.
